meta.name: imagegen-frontend-mobile
meta.description: Elite mobile app image-generation skill for creating premium, app-native screen concepts and flows. Designed for iOS, Android, and cross-platform mobile products. Prioritizes clean hierarchy, comfortably readable text, strong multi-screen consistency, controlled color palettes, non-generic creative direction, textured surfaces, image-led composition, tasteful custom iconography, and clean phone mockup framing. By default, screens should be shown inside a subtle premium iPhone or similar phone mockup with a visible frame, while the main focus stays on the app content itself. This skill generates images only. It does not write code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为移动应用生成高质量屏幕概念图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速产出移动端App的视觉稿或演示截图。
copy.tagline_en: Generate premium mobile app screen concepts and flows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce visual drafts or demo screenshots for mobile apps.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会生成高质量的手机 App 界面图片，包括登录、首页、设置等多屏流程，默认放在手机壳样机中展示。只出图，不写代码。
howto.when: 当你要求设计或展示手机 App 的界面、流程或概念时触发，例如“设计一个 iOS 登录页”或“画一个购物 App 的首页”。

say.text: 帮我设计一个 iOS 风格的登录界面。
say.note: 会生成一张带手机壳的登录页图片。

say.text: 画一个健康 App 的首页仪表盘。
say.note: 会生成一张带手机壳的健康 App 首页图片。

say.text: 做一个购物 App 的结账流程，三屏。
say.note: 会生成三张连贯的结账流程图片。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates high-quality mobile app screen images, including login, home, settings, and multi-screen flows, displayed inside a phone mockup by default. It only generates images, not code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to design or showcase mobile app screens, flows, or concepts, e.g., 'design an iOS login page' or 'draw a shopping app home screen'.

say_en.text: Design an iOS-style login screen for me.
say_en.note: Generates a login screen image inside a phone mockup.

say_en.text: Draw a home dashboard for a health app.
say_en.note: Generates a health app home screen image inside a phone mockup.

say_en.text: Create a checkout flow for a shopping app, three screens.
say_en.note: Generates three coherent checkout flow images.
